item.title: Cloud Platform Brief — Issue 1
item.description: Kubernetes 1.37 introduces alpha controls for hardening writable volumes. GitHub expands enterprise security enforcement, AI-development governance and automated coverage policies, while GCP changes the default representation for MongoDB-to-BigQuery streams. Architecture teams should review Kubernetes feature-gate pilots and validate downstream schemas before creating new Datastream pipelines. No AWS or Azure changes met the editorial threshold this week.
